text:
Harper: Drafting a tiny 'manager quickpass' — one page + calendar snippets + copy-paste who-to-ask. Goal: reduce first-week admin surprises. Thoughts?
Dev: Love the idea. Keep language super short, managers will skim. Include exact copy they can paste to IT/Security/Facilities.
Sam: Add a prioritized security checklist (MUST/ASAP/OPTIONAL). Also a 30/60/90 that starts with relationship goals, not deliverables.
Harper: OK. Draft outline below, aiming for <=3.5h scheduled.
Harper: Pre-start (2-3 days before): submit Okta & infra tickets, confirm laptop tracking, assign buddy, badge if office. Sample pre-start message included.
Lina: Sample pre-start buddy message (copy/paste): "Hi NAME — I'm starting on START_DATE. Can we do a 15m prep call DAY-BEFORE to go over laptop, VPN, and first-day plan?"
Dev: Day 1 (half day): 30m People Ops welcome, 20m HR admin, 30m team intro + expectations, 15m systems access check (Okta links + runbooks).
Sam: Day 2: 45m Product context & roadmap, 30m Security intro (how to escalate + key contacts), 30m buddy shadow.
Harper: Day 3: 45m 30/60/90 planning (manager-only, forkable template), 30m 1:1 kickoff for direct reports (pasteable agenda).
Lina: Day 4: 60m Ops & monitoring primer (alerts, SLOs, Redwood Console tour). Day 5: 30m Stakeholder intros + week recap.
Harper: Pasteable calendar bundle for offers:
- Day 0 16:00 Buddy prep call (15m)
- Day 1 09:30 People Ops welcome (50m)
- Day 1 11:00 Team intro (30m)
- Day 2 10:00 Product + Roadmap (45m)
- Day 3 10:00 30/60/90 planning (45m)
- Day 4 09:30 Ops primer (60m)
- Day 5 15:00 Stakeholder intro + recap (30m)
Sam: 30/60/90 starter (copyable):
- 30d: meet key partners, confirm all team access, ship one small process improvement.
- 60d: own a prioritized backlog item, establish weekly planning cadence, gather feedback.
- 90d: implement one measurable improvement, set draft OKRs, share progress with stakeholders.
Dev: 1:1 agenda snippet to paste: "Wins / Blockers / Priorities / Support needed" (15m).
Sam: Security checklist (copy/paste):
- MUST: enable MFA, confirm device encryption, Okta group access.
- ASAP: KMS request, runbook read access.
- OPTIONAL: audit/log access, extra alerts.
Harper: Who-to-ask quick lines (copy/paste):
- IT: "Hi IT — please provision Okta group ROLE and ship laptop to NAME by START_DATE."
- Security: "Hi Security — request KMS and runbook read access for NAME, ROLE, START_DATE."
- Facilities: "Badge + parking for NAME on START_DATE at BUILDING."
- Legal: "Please ensure NDAs & required contracts are queued for NAME."
Lina: Compliance flag: "If role handles regulated data, schedule Legal + Security intake in week 1."
Dev: Suggest a one-question EOW check: "Any unresolved access issues?" If yes, auto-tag IT. Keeps follow-up minimal.
Harper: I'll convert to a one-page PDF + Google Calendar template and post link here. Can folks review by Wednesday EOD?
Sam: I can review tomorrow morning.
Lina: Friday works for me.
OnboardBot: Manager quickpass draft uploaded to People Ops docs. Link: https://redwood.link/manager-quickpass-draft
Harper: Thanks — aim to include this in offer emails and the People Ops playbook once finalized. :sparkles:
